text.p: Anchor Financial Corp said Tuesday its board of directors approved a three-for-two stock split.
Anchor said in a statement the split will take the form of a 50 percent common stock dividend, payable on September 26 to shareholders of record on August 29.
"Shareholders...will be issued new stock certificates for whole shares and cash for fractional shares during the month of October," it said.

Before the split, the company had seven million common shares authorized at $6.00 par value each, of which 2.6 million shares were issued and outstanding, and 264,175 shares subject to options, it said.

After the split, it will have seven million shares authorized at the same par value, of which about 3.8 million shares will be issued and outstanding, and 396,263 shares will be subject to options, it said.
The company's stock was trading 1-1/2 higher at 37 in early Tuesday trading.
Anchor, with assets of $544.8 million, is the parent of The Anchor Bank with offices along the Carolina coast.
